values.meaning: per-side cooldown reduction per bonus attack speed
values.quote: reduced equivalent to {{fd|0.2}} {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}} per {{tt|{{as|1% '''bonus''' attack speed}}

mechanics.claim: Against the first target, Void Surge can critically strike and applies on-hit effects and life steal.
mechanics.quote: Against the first target, ''Void Surge'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Bel'Veth|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Void Surge resets Bel'Veth's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Void Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: Life steal heals based on damage dealt to the first target hit, while secondary targets heal spell vamp at reduced 33% effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell vamp}} will grant {{tip|heal|healing}} from the damage dealt to all targets, but healing from damage to secondary targets is reduced to 33% effectiveness.

mechanics.claim: Void Surge can only be cast within a cardinal direction that is off cooldown; each direction has its own cooldown.
mechanics.quote: ''Void Surge'' can be cast only within a cardinal direction that is off cooldown, and incurs a cooldown between casts.
